title: Golden gate's engine-compare branch is dead code — engine PPProbe output is never compared to the golden/standalone contract
evidence:
# If the engine probe already produced a file (gate order: probe runs first),
# compare engine vs standalone; otherwise standalone vs the committed golden.
if [ -f docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json ]; then
  A="docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json"
  B="$TMP/standalone.json"
  WHAT="engine PPProbe vs standalone spine-check"
--- and scripts/local-ci.sh:75 ---
  "ENGINE:PPProbe commandlet (headless spine probe)|scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe"
detail: Nothing writes docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json (repo-wide grep: only compare-golden.sh mentions it; gate 7 runs --probe with no --json-out; --bless overwrites the golden directly). The engine runner's state_hash/tick_nonce is never cross-checked — gate 7 greps only RESULT=OK. The cross-runner determinism contract the golden exists to pin is silently unenforced.
recommended_fix: Pass --json-out docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json in local-ci.sh gate 7 (and gitignore that path); add "rng_first4" to compare-golden.sh's compared-key list so the full probe artifact is checked.

title: Format gate is engine-skipped at this sha while system clang-format is present and 8/16 Source files would FAIL it
evidence:
"ENGINE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)|scripts/format-check.sh"
--- docs/timings.md:1 ---
2026-08-20T18:00:24	gate 1	ENGINE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)	SKIP	0s
--- verified on this machine (clang-format 22.1.8, accepted by format-check.sh's >=14 check) ---
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Hash.h
Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Hash.h:18:38: warning: code should be clang-formatted [-Wclang-format-violations]
(8 of 16 files fail: PP_Hash.h, PP_Rng.h, PP_Sim.h, PP_DeterminismTests.cpp, PP_HashTests.cpp, PP_RngTests.cpp, PPProbeCommandlet.cpp, PPProbeCommandlet.h — 69 violations total)
detail: Acceptance requires "local CI with engine-free gates green now" (briefing: "engine-free gates (format/spine/static) must be green at this sha"). The format gate skips despite format-check.sh's own system-clang-format fallback, hiding a failing gate — the false-green pattern AGENTS.md bans.
recommended_fix: Drop the ENGINE: prefix from the format gate (format-check.sh already handles engine-absent fallback), run clang-format -i over Source/ to clear the 69 violations, re-record timings.

title: spine-check hardcodes "ALL GREEN (34 checks)" but only 25 checks execute; README/PR/docs repeat the false count
evidence:
std::printf("spine-check: ALL GREEN (34 checks)\n");
--- README.md:19 ---
`tests/build/spine-check` reproduces the Odin pinned vectors byte-exact (34 checks green, no engine needed).
--- instrumented run of the same source (CHECK macro counting executions) ---
spine-check: ALL GREEN (25 checks executed)
detail: An instrumented copy executing the real CHECK macro counts 25 (8+4+5+4+4). The printed count is a hardcoded literal, not derived from execution; PR body, README, project-context.md and research-report all repeat "34 checks" — a fabricated verification metric.
recommended_fix: Add a counter incremented in the CHECK macro and print the real total; correct the "34 checks" claim in README.md, project-context.md, research-report.md/.html.
